tools.name: list_icons
tools.description: Get a list of all available Hugeicons icons

tools.name: search_icons
tools.description: Search for icons by name or tags. Returns icon metadata only (name, tags, categories). Use commas to search for multiple icons (e.g. 'home, notification, settings'). For comprehensive glyph data across styles, use get_icons_batch_with_glyphs instead.

query.description: Search query to find relevant icons. Separate multiple searches with commas

limit.description: Optional maximum number of results to return

exact_match.description: When true, only exact icon name matches are returned

offset.description: Optional number of results to skip before returning matches

include_metadata.description: When false, returns only icon names instead of full metadata

case_sensitive.description: When true, exact_match comparisons are case-sensitive

sort_by.description: Optional result ordering mode for search results

tags.description: Optional list of tags or categories to further filter matched icons

fields.description: Optional list of metadata fields to include when include_metadata is true

tools.name: get_platform_usage
tools.description: Get platform-specific usage instructions for Hugeicons

platform.description: Platform name (react, vue, angular, svelte, react-native, flutter, html)

tools.name: get_icon_glyphs
tools.description: Get all glyphs (unicode characters) for a single specific icon across all available styles. For retrieving glyphs for multiple icons efficiently, use get_icons_batch_with_glyphs.

tools.name: get_icon_glyph_by_style
tools.description: Get the glyph (unicode character) for a single specific icon with a particular style. Ideal for precise single icon-style lookups. For multiple icons or styles, consider get_icons_batch_with_glyphs.

tools.name: get_icons_batch_with_glyphs
tools.description: Retrieve detailed information including glyphs for multiple icons in a single request. Returns comprehensive data with all available styles and their unicode characters for each icon.

icon_names.description: Array of icon names to retrieve (e.g., ['home-01', 'notification-02', 'settings-03'])

include_styles.description: Optional array of specific styles to include. If omitted, all styles are returned.
